name: AELDARI: WINDRIDERS
description: Windriders pilot jetbikes that can cross leagues in the space of a few heartbeats. Mastering such incredible machines takes great skill, but Windriders are expected to do this and far more – in battle, they must also be able to shred what resistance they encounter with bursts of fire from the weapons attached to their jetbikes.This multipart plastic kit builds three Windriders, incredibly sleek jetbikes for your Aeldari armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. They are ideal for threatening large swathes of the battlefield and can pack a punch with their underslung weaponry. Each jetbike can have its twin shuriken catapult replaced with a shuriken cannon or scatter laser, and they can be assembled with an elevated HUD – ready to make their attack run.This kit comprises 72 plastic components, and 3x Citadel Small Flying Bases. This set also includes 1x Aeldari Transfer Sheet containing 378 high-quality waterslide transfers to customise your miniatures.These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
